overall.label: Intelligence framework online
overall.summary: The unified intelligence layer is active. Specialist tool adapters are the next integration phase.

systems.name: Site Health
systems.summary: Technical health signals will report status codes, canonical issues, indexability, and structural findings here.

systems.name: Search Intelligence
systems.summary: Search performance, query movement, Watchtower observations, and intervention outcomes will report here.

systems.name: Link Map
systems.summary: Cluster strength, internal-link support, orphan risk, and linking opportunities will report here.

systems.name: Curator Integrity
systems.summary: Standards, accessibility, metadata, structure, and editorial conformity signals will report here.

systems.name: Curator Speed
systems.summary: Performance findings and high-friction pages or assets will report here.

systems.name: Curator Indexer
systems.summary: Page inventory, coverage, classification, and structured content intelligence will report here.

opportunities.title: Connect the first specialist feed
opportunities.summary: Site Health is a strong first adapter because its findings can establish the normalization pattern for every other CuratorOS tool.

opportunities.title: Add cross-tool entity correlation
opportunities.summary: Once two or more feeds report URL-level signals, Curator Intelligence can merge them into one page dossier and calculate meaningful priorities.

activity.title: Curator Intelligence Center initialized
activity.summary: The former CuratorOS Tools launcher has been converted into a data-driven intelligence surface while preserving direct access to every specialist tool.

activity.title: Normalized intelligence schema established
activity.summary: Systems, priorities, opportunities, activity, and top-level status now share a common contract that live adapters can populate.
